history.summary: An unnamed 2028-completion freehold new-build at 27 Lor 32 Geylang (D14) — a 700 sqft 2BR at $1.5M / $2,143 psf, which is aggressive new-launch boutique pricing in deep Geylang with no URA track record. The high psf, no resale data, and a likely tiny development make this a speculative entry.
history.rating_rationale: $2,143 psf for a 700 sqft 2BR in a Lorong Geylang freehold boutique is steep new-launch pricing with zero URA appreciation or transaction history to validate it. A 2028 completion means buying off-plan with no project liquidity, and the deep-Geylang lorong address carries perception/tenant-mix sensitivity. The $1.5M quantum is reasonable in absolute terms, but you are paying top-of-market psf for an unproven boutique block — no margin of safety.
red_flags: $2,143 psf is high for boutique deep-Geylang freehold
No URA appreciation/transaction data — unproven pricing
2028 completion — off-plan, no resale liquidity yet
Likely small boutique development on a lorong — thin exit; Geylang perception sensitivity
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central / D14 redevelopment over the long run
